newsitem.title: UK: Unilever sells Japanese haircare business.
newsitem.headline: Unilever sells Japanese haircare business.

text.p: Unilever NV said on Monday it had agreed to sell its Helene Curtis professional haircare products business in Japan to Shiseido Co Ltd for an undisclosed sum.

Unilever said the business had net sales of around 25 million stg last year and employed around 120 people. Unilever said it bought the worldwide Helene Curtis business last year for around $770 million.
Unilever said the disposal of its Helene Curtis business in Japan was part of its strategy to focus on consumer businesses. Shiseido wanted to expand its hair salon activities.
Last year, Unilever sold its Helene Curtis haircase products business in the U.S. and Canada to Shiseido International Corporation.
